title: Pneumatic — Installation of the Valve Position Sensing Harness in the Pylon and Belly Fairing

issue.reason: Initial issue of the valve position sensing harness installation bulletin.

abstract: Installation of the harness that carries valve position from the four bleed valve positions to the bleed monitoring computer, written as a separate bulletin so that it can be done at a check where the belly fairing is already open.

sections.planning_reason: The position sensing harness was installed on the production line from MSN C00512 onward, and aircraft delivered before that have no wiring between the valve positions and the bleed monitoring computer. Pulling the harness is the longest single task in the four-position valve retrofit and it needs the belly fairing open, which most operators would rather do at a check they have already planned. Writing it as its own bulletin lets the harness go in at one visit and the valves at another.
sections.description: The bulletin installs the position sensing harness between the four bleed valve positions, the pylon disconnect and the bleed monitoring computer, and installs the connector provisions at each valve boss. No valve or actuator is changed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the belly fairing in zone 191 and the fan cowls on both sides. Route the harness from the bleed monitoring computer position to the pylon disconnect on each side, following the existing support line, and secure it at every clip. Install the connector provision at each of the four valve positions and cap it. Install the loop clamps and the protective sleeving where the harness crosses the duct in zones 443 and 444. Do a continuity and insulation resistance check on every conductor and record the values. Do the bonding check at the pylon disconnect. Cap and stow the four valve-end connectors. Close the belly fairing and the fan cowls and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft up to MSN C00512 that were delivered without the position sensing harness. Aircraft from MSN C00512 onward already carry the harness.
sections.material_note: Kit K3620-2009-01 contains the harness, the four connector provisions, the clamp set and the sleeving. Lead time is fourteen weeks. Nothing is returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At a scheduled check where the belly fairing is already open, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin.

title: Pneumatic — Installation of the Valve Position Sensing Harness in the Pylon and Belly Fairing

issue.reason: Ordering constraint against the valve bulletin stated here as a prerequisite, matching the requirement reference added on that bulletin.

abstract: Installation of the harness that carries valve position from the four bleed valve positions to the bleed monitoring computer, written as a separate bulletin so that it can be done ahead of the valve work.

sections.planning_reason: The position sensing harness was installed on the production line from MSN C00512 onward, and aircraft delivered before that have no wiring between the valve positions and the bleed monitoring computer. Pulling the harness is the longest single task in the four-position valve retrofit and it needs the belly fairing open, which most operators would rather do at a check they have already planned. Writing it as its own bulletin lets the harness go in at one visit and the valves at another. Splitting the work that way was the right commercial decision, but it created an ordering constraint that neither document stated: the valves have nothing to report position to until this harness exists, and a valve bulletin accomplished first leaves four capped connectors and a monitoring computer that declares a sensing fault on every flight. The constraint is now written in both directions, here as a prerequisite and on the valve bulletin as a requirement.
sections.description: The bulletin installs the position sensing harness between the four bleed valve positions, the pylon disconnect and the bleed monitoring computer, and installs the connector provisions at each valve boss. No valve or actuator is changed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the belly fairing in zone 191 and the fan cowls on both sides. Route the harness from the bleed monitoring computer position to the pylon disconnect on each side, following the existing support line, and secure it at every clip. Install the connector provision at each of the four valve positions and cap it. Install the loop clamps and the protective sleeving where the harness crosses the duct in zones 443 and 444. Do a continuity and insulation resistance check on every conductor and record the values. Do the bonding check at the pylon disconnect. Cap and stow the four valve-end connectors. Close the belly fairing and the fan cowls and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft up to MSN C00512 that were delivered without the position sensing harness. It must be accomplished before Service Bulletin CRN-36-2005 and there is no sequence in which the two can be reversed. Aircraft from MSN C00512 onward already carry the harness.
sections.material_note: Kit K3620-2009-01 contains the harness, the four connector provisions, the clamp set and the sleeving. Lead time is fourteen weeks. Nothing is returned.

type_data.compliance_time: Before the accomplishment of Service Bulletin CRN-36-2005, and preferably at a scheduled check where the belly fairing is already open.

revision_history.reason: Prerequisite relationship to CRN-36-2005 stated in the planning and effectivity information; matching requirement reference added on that bulletin
